summary: Latin Rite shrine with a clear schedule in all three bulletins: Sunday 9 and 11, a 7:30 AM Low Mass Mon-Wed/Fri/Sat, Thursday 12:10, English Masses Tue/Wed 12:10 and Saturday 4:00, a first-Friday 6:00 PM Mass, plus adoration Thursday 6 PM and Friday noon. Confessions are 30 minutes before each Latin Mass (recorded as the policy's relative rule, 30 minutes ending at Mass). Open questions: confession during adoration (Thu, Fri), first-Friday confession, and an unspecified Oct 25 Benediction; the Oct 24 relic veneration, Oct 12 and Oct 25 specials and the Nov 5 cemetery Mass are left out.

entry.note: Benediction after the 11:00 AM High Mass

sources.said: Sunday, October 25th ... 9:00 a.m. Low Mass, 11:00 High Mass featuring the "Missa Brevis" of Mariano Garau & Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament

slots.rationale: Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament is announced for the Feast of Christ the King on Oct 25 but with no start time; it is part of the 11:00 High Mass announcement. Policy treats Benediction as Adoration, and a relative 'after' a weekend Mass would be one hour after the Mass starts (12:00 PM), a guess. Left out as the leaning because there is no definite time. Reviewer timing rule (2026-10-14), confirmed by the user pointing out this parish: record the Benediction associated with the 11:00 AM Sunday High Mass one hour after Mass starts, at 12:00 PM. No end time is stated.
slots.question: Add an Oct 25 Benediction (Adoration) at 12:00 PM, one hour after the 11:00 AM High Mass?
